transcript.content: Before we talk charts — who acts on this and what would they do differently?
My CSMs. Right now they only find out an account is unhappy once it's cancelling.
So the real win is catching at-risk accounts early. What signals count as at-risk, and where does that data live?
Usage dropping, downgrades, ticket spikes. Usage is in our Postgres, billing's in Stripe.
Given one part-time eng, I'd skip the fancy dashboard and ship a weekly at-risk list to your CSMs first. Prove it drives saves, then invest.
How big is this? We can't babysit another service.
One scheduled query + an email. No new infra, no daily ops. If it earns its keep we harden it.

human.summary: Excellent discovery, right-sized scope, handled Marcus well.
